newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan loan defaults rise to 113 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan loan defaults rise to 113 bln rupees.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Thursday the banking and financial system was burdened by non-performing loans and poor recovery.

It said in its annual report that non-performing advances of banks and development financial institutions had risen 12 percent to 113.2 billion rupees at the end of fiscal 1995/96 (July-June) from 101 billion rupees a year earlier.

These bad debts accounted for 18.8 percent of the total loan portfolio, the central bank said. Some 16 billion rupees were recovered in 1995/96, while loans totalling 20 billion rupees were restructured. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
